name: study-partner
description: Study Partner: Modern, private collaborative video workspace with persistent rooms

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
